stance_rationale: DPL-RC is a coherent design protocol, but the submitted draft cannot be accepted as an alpha package because required empirical artifacts, challenge note, IC diagnostics, time-series alpha, and PIT lineage are absent. The package repeatedly converts future Forge work into present-tense compliance claims.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, and covariance.parquet are missing from the requested qepm artifact paths, so Date x Ticker x score, schedule, and post-shrink PSD/condition checks cannot be performed.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: No factor_engine_proposal.R or factor-level lineage proves Z_Score_Aligned-only usage; the design only says per-sig_date z-score normalization.
Usable_Date <= sig_date is asserted via inherited v2 PIT audit, but no current artifact_lineage or feature audit is present.
No load_month_factors() path is evidenced; package references parquet-derived feature artifacts and inherited files instead.
p_bad(t+1) versus p_bad(t) notation is inconsistent, and the admission pseudo-code shifts target and prediction together, leaving off-by-one overlay risk unresolved.
Quarterly 45d and annual May lag rules are stated, but no implementation or per-feature usable-date proof is supplied.

critical_concerns.description: Required verification artifacts are missing: qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260517_003, alpha_scores.parquet, covariance.parquet, weights.csv, factor_engine_proposal.R, alpha_package.json, risk_package.json, optimization_package.json, and challenge_note.md were not present. This blocks time-series alpha, PSD, schedule, No Silent Override, and AX-008 verification.

The draft reports harvey_t_count=5 and self-checks as ALL PASS while rank_IC, ICIR, Harvey t, DSR, monotonicity, sub-stability, and cost-adjusted OOS metrics are explicitly deferred to Forge. Harness-only performance is the only valid evidence.

The weakest modeling premise is that a LightGBM p_bad classifier can forecast next-month 1715 bad states from 124 monthly sig_dates, roughly 25-30 bad labels, 80 features, and 9 label-definition choices without label-selection overfit.

PIT compliance is inherited rather than proven for this worktask. C13/C14/C15/C4 cannot pass without current feature lineage, load_month_factors() evidence, usable-date checks, and sign-alignment audit.

The conditional injection formula alternates between p_bad_1715(t+1) and p_bad_1715(t), while pseudo-code aligns shifted predictions with shifted labels. This is an unresolved same-period/off-by-one leakage risk for the overlay.

AX-005 is marked N/A, but the design is explicitly defensive-heavy and crisis/bad-state oriented. Multi-sleeve status is necessary, not sufficient; Gate13-style crisis_alpha, MDD relief, and bad/normal IC evidence are still required.

AX-007 exemption is asserted before weights exist. The complement sleeve is still top-20 long-only score-proportional sizing, so the single_sleeve_long_only_top20 mechanism-break risk remains unverified.

Universe and liquidity definitions are inconsistent: KR_TOP500_LIQ1E8, feature-build liquidity 50M, and production liquidity 200M coexist, while the hard universe is KOSPI200 union KOSDAQ150 with 20d TV >= 2e8 KRW.
The mechanism description is 658 characters despite the alpha checklist requiring under 200 characters, and several KR-transfer statements remain priors rather than measured KR evidence.

supporting_arguments: The design correctly reframes v1/v2 failure toward 1715 complement rather than replacement.
G1 hard abort, 7-axis admission, and staged Linear/EN/LightGBM/Neural comparison are useful controls if actually implemented.
Small a_max injection and good-state drag limits are aligned with production-lineage preservation.
unresolved_disputes: Whether a design-only Phase A package is allowed to omit alpha_scores while still claiming compliance/self-check PASS.
Whether p_bad label selection across 9 candidates is included in DSR and multiple-testing correction.
Whether v2 inherited PIT artifacts are available, canonical, and applicable to this WT without drift.
Whether 1715 baseline weights/returns used for labels are frozen, PIT-clean, and same-harness comparable.
weakest_assumption: A 124-month, 80-feature p_bad classifier can reliably forecast next-month 1715 bad states after label-definition search, and the resulting complement remains orthogonal enough to improve SR/MDD without good-state drag.
rebuttal_required: Provide alpha_scores.parquet with Date x Ticker x score and at least 60 monthly sig_dates, plus weights.csv schedule validation.
Provide rank_IC, ICIR, Harvey/Newey-West t, DSR, monotonicity, sub-stability, turnover, and liquidity diagnostics.
Provide factor_engine_proposal.R or equivalent implementation proving PIT C13/C14/C15/C9/C4.
Provide challenge_note.md covering RF-A1 through RF-A7 and artifact_lineage write_json to record_lineage ordering.
Recompute DSR with the full effective trial count from label definitions, stages, a_max grid, lambda grid, and random search.
Replace AX-005 and AX-007 N/A/PASS assertions with empirical exclusion evidence.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Only alpha draft and design-stage markdown artifacts were available; Forge/Architect empirical PASS sources are absent, so AX-008 cannot be credited.

alpha_specific_questions: Can p_bad and complement performance maintain t_NW > 2.95 after full multiple-testing correction over labels, stages, a_max, lambda grid, and random trials?
Does the alpha vector have future leakage, especially around p_bad(t+1), bad_state labels, and fundamental usable-date lag?
If AX-005/AX-007 exclusions are invoked, what empirical evidence shows the exclusions are sufficient rather than only formally necessary?
